title: Smithbucklin Acquires McKinley Advisors
summary:
CHICAGO — Smithbucklin acquired McKinley Advisors, an award-winning association consultancy.   McKinley Advisors will retain its name, brand, current leadership team, staff and proven methodologies while leveraging new opportunities to collaborate across the Smithbucklin enterprise.   According to Smithbucklin, this combination of businesses, supported by its event-focused agency 360 Live Media, creates a unique solution in the marketplace to drive association growth, innovation and mission impact.   Smithbucklin will use the organization’s expertise in research, strategy, governance and business transformation to expand its portfolio.   “Contemporary associations increasingly need […]
